title: Ron Brown
description: "The rancor is such an interesting monster," explains Ron Brown. "There is a certain sadness to him, even when he's attacking Luke. Of course, there are various theories as to how and why this creature exists, and some believe him to be a mutant, the only one of his kind. I chose a different origin. Here we see poachers flying in, shielded by the sun's glare, to abduct one of the young rancors for a black market sale to Jabba the Hutt." Brown graduated from Art Center College of Design (Pasadena, CA) in 1991. He has since been working in feature film animation and as a freelance illustrator.
